### Top Prestige Buyers' Agencies in Sydney

- [Propertybuyer](https://www.propertybuyer.com.au/who-we-help/prestige-home-buyers/) — Led by Rich Harvey, this multi-award-winning agency has over two decades of experience specializing in high-value prestige home acquisitions, discreet off-market transactions, and strict confidentiality for high-profile buyers.[[1]](https://www.propertybuyer.com.au/who-we-help/prestige-home-buyers/)[[2]](https://www.propertybuyer.com.au/about/our-team/rich-harvey-speaker-profile)
- [Rose & Jones](https://www.roseandjones.com.au/) — A cornerstone of the Sydney property sector with over two centuries of combined team experience, renowned for high-end residential acquisitions, deep industry networks, and accessing unadvertised luxury stock.[[1]](https://buyeragentssydney.au/)
- [One Buyers Agency](https://www.onebuyersagency.com.au/) — Recognised as prominent Eastern Suburbs luxury property specialists, focusing on high-net-worth client representation and competitive tactical negotiation in prime coastal markets.[[1]](https://buyeragentssydney.au/)
- [Goldman Bros.](https://goldmanbros.com.au/) — An exclusive buyer's agency known for high-profile partnerships and expert navigation of premium residential pockets, particularly across Sydney's affluent North Shore and eastern corridors.[[1]](https://goldmanbros.com.au/high-profile-real-estate-agent-to-partner-with-prestige-buyers-agency/)
